description: Cross-profile attribute equivalences: which differently-named attributes carry the same measurement. Validated by ci/lint-attribute-aliases.mjs against the profiles themselves — wire kind, unit, and the full delivery contract (delivery / scope / promotion) must agree for every member, or the build fails. See validation/attribute-alias-schema.json for why this is not kpis/*.json inputMappings.

semantics.meaning: The machine is currently executing its production cycle — TRUE between the start and the end of one part's making, FALSE otherwise. Each profile names the cycle after its own process (machining / injection); the predicate is the same one, and it is what every cycle-gated rule in the fleet keys on.

Instantaneous electrical power draw of the machine in kilowatts — a RATE, not a meter reading. It is the quantity the central OEE & Energy cockpit integrates; the cumulative energy counter (Act_Energy_Total) is a different semantic and is deliberately not a member here.
